import re from typing import List def detect_html_tags(html_str: str) -> List[str]: """ Return a list of all HTML tags found in the input string. Parameters ---------- html_str : str The HTML content to search for tags. Returns ------- List[str] A list of tag strings, e.g. ['
', '', '

']. """ # Compile a non‑greedy pattern that matches anything between < and > tag_pattern = re.compile(r'<[^>]+?>') # Find all matches; return an empty list if none are found return tag_pattern.findall(html_str) or []
